answer: Across the garden, a single honest agent and a thousand-strong clone farm are measured by the same ruler: cost per identity. A stake that vests on good behaviour turns each fake into a hostage: behave and it returns, spam and it is gone. The falcon prices misbehaviour directly — the attacker must fund every clone up front and loses the stake on every clone the graders catch. The nebula turns sybil resistance into bookkeeping: if the cost per fake exceeds the reward per fake, the attack dies.
